data.rationale: The proposal gets the caniuse → MDN → mail-draft steps in the right order with matching subject and body templates, but it gets the ending wrong: it says Send, while the true workflow says Discard and never Send, and it drops closing the MDN tab. It also leaves out the 'not supported yet' case, splits {customer} into separate email and name parameters that aren't linked, and uses {name} in the body even though no such parameter exists, so an automation built from it would be ambiguous and could do harm.
